title: The luminiferous aether as the medium for light propagation (a known dead end)

held_out_paper.citation: Fresnel, A. (1818). Memoire sur la diffraction de la lumiere.

ground_truth_hypothesis: Light propagates as a mechanical wave through an all-pervading elastic medium, the luminiferous aether, which fills all space and supports transverse oscillations; the Earth's motion through this stationary aether should produce a measurable directional dependence in the speed of light.
note: FALSE. The aether was overturned by the null result of Michelson-Morley (1887) and special relativity (1905). It fit the wave theory of light beautifully, which is exactly why it is a strong adversarial case: narrative fit is high but the central 'aether wind' prediction was never observed.

prior_literature.title: Traite de la lumiere
claims: Light exhibits wave-like behavior and can be described by propagating wavefronts.
A wave requires a medium through which to propagate.
Every point on a wavefront acts as a source of secondary wavelets.

prior_literature.title: On the theory of light and colours (double-slit interference)
claims: Light passing through two slits produces an interference pattern.
Interference implies light is a wave phenomenon.
The wavelength of light can be inferred from the fringe spacing.

prior_literature.title: Opticks: reflections, refractions, inflections and colours of light
claims: White light is composed of a spectrum of colors separable by a prism.
Light travels in straight lines and can be refracted at interfaces.
Mechanical media transmit disturbances at a finite characteristic speed.
